## Libraries

```{r libraries r}

library(qualtRics)
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor) 
library(stringr)
library(apollo) # for analysis
library(readxl) # for loading design
```

## Load Datasets & Design

```{r load data & design}

qt_labels <- read_survey(file.choose())

qt_values <- read_survey(file.choose())

design <- read_excel("C:/Users/mykha/Documents/Photovoice/SCORCH DCE Experimental Design Positly.xlsx",sheet = "Design | Choice Tasks") |>clean_names()

# to maintain original data, create duplicate dataframes to work in from this point forward
df.labs <- qt_labels
df.vals <- qt_values
```

## Rename & Clean Both Datasets

```{r clean datasets}

# drop IP addresses
df.labs <- df.labs |>
  select(-Status)

df.vals <- df.vals |>
  select(-Status)

# janitor::cleannames() tidies & standardizes all column names
df.labs <- df.labs |> clean_names() 
df.vals <- df.vals |> clean_names()

# rename dce questions in both dataframes
rename_map <- c(
  practice_question = "choice_set1",
  a1 = "q2_21",
  a2 = "q3_22",
  a3 = "q4_23",
  a4 = "q5_24",
  a5 = "q6_25",
  a6 = "q7_26",
  a7 = "q8_27",
  a8 = "q9_28",
  a9 = "q10",
  b1 = "q1",
  b2 = "q2_31",
  b3 = "q3_32",
  b4 = "q4_33",
  b5 = "q5_34",
  b6 = "q6_35",
  b7 = "q7_36",
  b8 = "q8_37",
  b9 = "q9_38")

df.labs <- df.labs |> rename(all_of(rename_map))
df.vals <- df.vals |> rename(all_of(rename_map))

# rename other questions
rename_map2 <- c(
  south_az = "sa",
  volunteer = "q144",
  why_sf_text = "q110",
  age = "age_63",
  gender = "gender_64",
  household = "q142",
  household_u18 = "q143",
  yrs_az = "az",
  state = "q111",
  state_51_text = "q111_51_text",
  positly_response_id = "participant_id",
  positly_age = "age_84",
  positly_gender = "gender_85",
  positly_income = "householdincome")

df.labs <- df.labs |> rename(all_of(rename_map2))
df.vals <- df.vals |> rename(all_of(rename_map2))

# use filter() to drop rows that are not from southern az, have an unfinished survey, and did not consent to survey
# use remove_empty() to drop all columns where every single value is NA
df.labs <- df.labs |> 
  filter(finished == TRUE,
         south_az == "Yes",
         consent == "Yes, I consent.") |>
  remove_empty("cols")
df.vals <- df.vals |>
  filter(finished == 1,
         south_az == 1,
         consent == 1) |>
  remove_empty("cols") |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric)))

# note: volunteer question was dropped because all responses were NA, question was probably added to survey after positly runs were completed

```

## Recoding & Cleaning for `df.vals` Only

```{r recode & clean df.vals only}

# convert multiple select questions to characters & use stringr::str_detect() to create T/F dummy columns
df.vals <- df.vals |>
  mutate(across(c(race, membership, use, type, mode_transport), as.character)) |>
  mutate(
    race_white            = str_detect(race, "1"),
    race_black            = str_detect(race, "2"),
    race_native_american  = str_detect(race, "3"),
    race_asian            = str_detect(race, "4"),
    race_pacific_islander = str_detect(race, "5"),
    race_other            = str_detect(race, "6"),
    race_prefer           = str_detect(race, "7"),
    membership_community_member    = str_detect(membership, "1"),
    membership_coalition_member    = str_detect(membership, "2"),
    membership_community_org       = str_detect(membership, "3"),
    membership_org_leader          = str_detect(membership, "4"),
    membership_local_gov           = str_detect(membership, "5"),
    membership_policy_maker        = str_detect(membership, "6"),
    membership_greenspace_designer = str_detect(membership, "7"),
    membership_other               = str_detect(membership, "8"),
    membership_prefer              = str_detect(membership, "9"),
    use_exercise_sports = str_detect(use, "1"),
    use_garden          = str_detect(use, "2"),
    use_relax           = str_detect(use, "3"),
    use_social          = str_detect(use, "4"),
    use_other           = str_detect(use, "5"),
    type_city_neighborhood_park   = str_detect(type, "1"),
    type_desert_natural_area      = str_detect(type, "2"),
    type_walk_bike                = str_detect(type, "3"),
    type_community_garden         = str_detect(type, "4"),
    type_private_yard             = str_detect(type, "5"),
    type_school_greenspace        = str_detect(type, "6"),
    type_golf_recreational_area   = str_detect(type, "7"),
    type_other                    = str_detect(type, "8"),
    mode_transport_walk             = str_detect(mode_transport, "1"),
    mode_transport_bike             = str_detect(mode_transport, "2"),
    mode_transport_personal_vehicle = str_detect(mode_transport, "3"),
    mode_transport_public_transit   = str_detect(mode_transport, "4"),
    mode_transport_rideshare_taxi   = str_detect(mode_transport, "5"),
    mode_transport_other            = str_detect(mode_transport, "6"))

# check to see that the above code worked
df.vals |> select(race, starts_with("race_")) |> head(10)
df.vals |> select(membership, starts_with("membership_")) |> head(10)
df.vals |> select(use, starts_with("use_")) |> head(10)
df.vals |> select(type, starts_with("type_")) |> head(10)
df.vals |> select(mode_transport, starts_with("mode_transport_")) |> head(10)

# drop original multi select columns since theyre redundant
df.vals <- df.vals |> 
  select(-c(mode_transport, type, use, race, membership))

# convert remaining numeric columns into factors, excluding metadata & choice tasks
# ! is used to exclude columns 
df.vals <- df.vals |> 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric) 
                & !matches("^[ab][1-9]$")
                & !c(age, positly_age, household, household_u18, zipcode, duration_in_seconds, progress, q_recaptcha_score, signature_size, practice_question),factor)) 

# in qualtrics, a1 had different answer choice lvls (2/4) then the rest of the choice tasks (1/2). Recode a1 to match the rest.
df.vals <- df.vals |>
  mutate(a1 = case_when(a1 == 2 ~ 1, a1 == 4 ~ 2, TRUE ~ a1))
```

## Reformat `df.vals`

```{r long reformat}

# create a new dataframe to store the reformation
survey_long <- df.vals |>
  select(response_id, matches("^[ab][1-9]$")) |>
  pivot_longer( #reshapes data to long format
    cols = matches("^[ab][1-9]$"),
    names_to = c("block", "choice_situation"),
    names_pattern = "([ab])(\\d+)",
    values_to = "choice") |>
  mutate(
    choice_situation = as.integer(choice_situation),
    block = case_when(block == "a" ~ 1, block == "b" ~ 2)) |>
  filter(!is.na(choice))

# recode survey_long's choice_situation to match the designs continuous numbering
survey_long <- survey_long |>
  mutate(choice_situation = if_else(block == 2, choice_situation + 9L, choice_situation))

#inspect and verify design date 
excel_sheets("C:/Users/mykha/Documents/Photovoice/SCORCH DCE Experimental Design Positly.xlsx")
dim(design)
names(design)

# code to check that the choice_situation numbering matches the design
survey_long |> distinct(block, choice_situation) |> arrange(block, choice_situation)
design |> distinct(block, choice_situation) |> arrange(block, choice_situation)
```

## Join `survey_long`, `design`, and demographic data together

```{r join}

# first, create a new dataframe to store the joining of survey_long & design
dce_data <- survey_long |>
  left_join(design, by = c("block", "choice_situation"))

# second, create another dataframe that has specific demographic data pulled from df.vals, excluding demographic data that is irrelevant to analysis 
dce.demo <- df.vals |>
  select(-matches("^[ab][1-9]$"), -matches("_text$"), -practice_question,
         -start_date, -end_date, -progress, -duration_in_seconds, -finished, 
         -recorded_date, -distribution_channel, -user_language, -q_recaptcha_score, 
         -consent, -qc_agree, -comments, -adult, -south_az,
         -starts_with("positly"), -starts_with("signature"))

# third, recode T/F columns to 1/0, respectively
dce.demo <- dce.demo |> 
  mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.integer))

# lastly, create analysis ready dataset
final_data <- dce_data |> 
  left_join(dce.demo, by = "response_id") |> 
  mutate(avail_1 = 1, avail_2 = 1)

# quality check
dim(final_data)

sum(is.na(dce_data$alt1_proximity))

sum(is.na(final_data$response_id))

table(final_data$block)

table(final_data$choice)

# confirm that every one of 756 choices matched its inteded experimental design
sum(is.na(dce_data$alt1_proximity))

# CHECK FOR ALTERNATIVE A CHOICE PATTERN

# Count how many times each participant selected Alternative A
a_choice_count <- final_data |>
  group_by(response_id) |>
  summarise(
    times_chose_A = sum(choice == 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Count how many participants selected Alternative A
# 1 through 9 times across their 9 choice tasks
a_choice_summary <- a_choice_count |>
  count(times_chose_A, name = "number_of_participants") |>
  complete(
    times_chose_A = 1:9,
    fill = list(number_of_participants = 0)
  ) |>
  filter(times_chose_A >= 1)

a_choice_summary

# RESHAPE DCE DATA TO ALTERNATIVE-LONG FORMAT

# Create one row per alternative (A or B) for each choice task
dce_long <- final_data |>
  
# Make DCE attribute levels consistent before reshaping
  mutate(
    across(
      matches("^alt[12]_(proximity|amenities|plant|safety|shade|accessibility)$"),
      as.integer
    )
  ) |>
  
# Reshape Park A and Park B from separate columns into separate rows
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("^alt[12]_(proximity|amenities|plant|safety|shade|accessibility)$"),
    names_to = c("alternative", "attribute"),
    names_pattern = "alt([12])_(.*)",
    values_to = "level"
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = attribute,
    values_from = level,
    names_prefix = "dce_"
  ) |>
  
# Label alternative 1 as A and alternative 2 as B
  mutate(
    alternative = if_else(alternative == "1", "A", "B")
  )

# Check the new long-format dataset
dim(dce_long)
table(dce_long$alternative)

# Create choice indicator and alternative-specific constant variables
dce_long <- dce_long |>
  mutate(
    chosen = case_when(
      choice == 1 & alternative == "A" ~ 1,
      choice == 2 & alternative == "B" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    asca = if_else(alternative == "A", 1, 0),
    ascb = if_else(alternative == "B", 1, 0)
  )
# Check choice and ASC coding
table(dce_long$alternative, dce_long$chosen)

table(dce_long$alternative, dce_long$asca)

table(dce_long$alternative, dce_long$ascb)

sum(dce_long$chosen)

# Inspect the long-format DCE variables
dce_long |>
  select(
    response_id,
    choice_situation,
    alternative,
    chosen,
    asca,
    ascb,
    dce_proximity,
    dce_amenities,
    dce_plant,
    dce_safety,
    dce_shade,
    dce_accessibility
  ) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)
```

```{r model}


# SET UP APOLLO CHOICE MODEL


# Initialize Apollo
apollo_initialise()

# Use original choice-task dataset for Apollo MNL
database <- final_data

# Add new variable long_term_az
database <- database |>
  mutate(
    long_term_az = if_else(yrs_az == 6, 1, 0)
  )

# Convert DCE attribute levels to integers
database <- database |>
  mutate(
    across(
      c(
        alt1_proximity, alt1_amenities, alt1_plant,
        alt1_safety, alt1_shade, alt1_accessibility,
        alt2_proximity, alt2_amenities, alt2_plant,
        alt2_safety, alt2_shade, alt2_accessibility
      ),
      as.integer
    )
  )

# Verify that each DCE attribute is coded using three levels
sort(unique(database$alt1_proximity))
sort(unique(database$alt1_amenities))
sort(unique(database$alt1_plant))
sort(unique(database$alt1_safety))
sort(unique(database$alt1_shade))
sort(unique(database$alt1_accessibility))

# Define Apollo model settings
# Each participant completed multiple DCE choice tasks
apollo_control <- list(
  modelName       = "MNL_DCE",
  modelDescr      = "MNL model of greenspace preferences",
  indivID         = "response_id",
  outputDirectory = "output"
)

# Check analysis dataset
dim(database)
table(database$choice)

# Load attribute definitions from the experimental design
attribute_levels <- read_excel(
  "C:/Users/mykha/Documents/Photovoice/SCORCH DCE Experimental Design Positly.xlsx",
  sheet = "Attributes"
)

attribute_levels



# DEFINE MODEL PARAMETERS


# Starting values for the ASC and attribute-level coefficients
# A starting value of 0 does not mean the coefficient is fixed at 0

apollo_beta <- c(
  
  # Alternative-specific constant for Alternative A
  # Alternative B is the reference
  asc_A = 0,
  
  # Proximity
  b_proximity_1 = 0,
  b_proximity_2 = 0,
  b_proximity_3 = 0,
  
  # Amenities
  b_amenities_1 = 0,
  b_amenities_2 = 0,
  b_amenities_3 = 0,
  
  # Plant type
  b_plant_1 = 0,
  b_plant_2 = 0,
  b_plant_3 = 0,
  
  # Interaction: Plant type x Arizona residency
  b_plant_1_az = 0,
  b_plant_3_az = 0,
  
  # Safety
  b_safety_1 = 0,
  b_safety_2 = 0,
  b_safety_3 = 0,
  
  # Shade
  b_shade_1 = 0,
  b_shade_2 = 0,
  b_shade_3 = 0,
  
  # Accessibility
  b_accessibility_1 = 0,
  b_accessibility_2 = 0,
  b_accessibility_3 = 0
)

# Set one level of each attribute as the reference category
#
# References:
# Proximity: level 3 = 1 mile
# Amenities: level 3 = no additional amenities
# Plant: level 2 = mix of native and non-native plants
# Safety: level 1 = no safety features
# Shade: level 3 = no shade
# Accessibility: level 3 = no paths/no accessibility routes

apollo_fixed <- c(
  "b_proximity_3",
  "b_amenities_3",
  "b_plant_2",
  "b_safety_1",
  "b_shade_3",
  "b_accessibility_3"
)

# Validate the database and model settings
apollo_inputs <- apollo_validateInputs()


# ================================================================
# DEFINE MODEL AND LIKELIHOOD FUNCTION
# ================================================================

# Define the MNL probability function
apollo_probabilities <- function(
  apollo_beta,
  apollo_inputs,
  functionality = "estimate"
) {
  
  # Make model parameters and database variables available
  # within the probability function
  apollo_attach(apollo_beta, apollo_inputs)
  on.exit(apollo_detach(apollo_beta, apollo_inputs))
  
  # Create list of probabilities
  P <- list()
  
  # Define utilities for the two park alternatives
  V <- list()
  
  # Alternative A / Park 1
  # Includes the ASC for Alternative A
  V[["park1"]] <-
    asc_A +
    b_proximity_1     * (alt1_proximity == 1) +
    b_proximity_2     * (alt1_proximity == 2) +
    b_proximity_3     * (alt1_proximity == 3) +
    b_amenities_1     * (alt1_amenities == 1) +
    b_amenities_2     * (alt1_amenities == 2) +
    b_amenities_3     * (alt1_amenities == 3) +
    b_plant_1         * (alt1_plant == 1) +
    b_plant_2         * (alt1_plant == 2) +
    b_plant_3         * (alt1_plant == 3) +
    b_plant_1_az * (alt1_plant == 1) * long_term_az +
    b_plant_3_az * (alt1_plant == 3) * long_term_az +
    b_safety_1        * (alt1_safety == 1) +
    b_safety_2        * (alt1_safety == 2) +
    b_safety_3        * (alt1_safety == 3) +
    b_shade_1         * (alt1_shade == 1) +
    b_shade_2         * (alt1_shade == 2) +
    b_shade_3         * (alt1_shade == 3) +
    b_accessibility_1 * (alt1_accessibility == 1) +
    b_accessibility_2 * (alt1_accessibility == 2) +
    b_accessibility_3 * (alt1_accessibility == 3)
  
  # Alternative B / Park 2
  # Alternative B is the reference for the ASC
  V[["park2"]] <-
    b_proximity_1     * (alt2_proximity == 1) +
    b_proximity_2     * (alt2_proximity == 2) +
    b_proximity_3     * (alt2_proximity == 3) +
    b_amenities_1     * (alt2_amenities == 1) +
    b_amenities_2     * (alt2_amenities == 2) +
    b_amenities_3     * (alt2_amenities == 3) +
    b_plant_1         * (alt2_plant == 1) +
    b_plant_2         * (alt2_plant == 2) +
    b_plant_3         * (alt2_plant == 3) +
    b_plant_1_az * (alt2_plant == 1) * long_term_az +
    b_plant_3_az * (alt2_plant == 3) * long_term_az +
    b_safety_1        * (alt2_safety == 1) +
    b_safety_2        * (alt2_safety == 2) +
    b_safety_3        * (alt2_safety == 3) +
    b_shade_1         * (alt2_shade == 1) +
    b_shade_2         * (alt2_shade == 2) +
    b_shade_3         * (alt2_shade == 3) +
    b_accessibility_1 * (alt2_accessibility == 1) +
    b_accessibility_2 * (alt2_accessibility == 2) +
    b_accessibility_3 * (alt2_accessibility == 3)
  
  # Connect the two utility functions to the observed
  # choice and availability variables
  mnl_settings <- list(
    alternatives = c(park1 = 1, park2 = 2),
    avail        = list(
      park1 = avail_1,
      park2 = avail_2
    ),
    choiceVar = choice,
    utilities = V
  )
  
  # Calculate MNL choice probabilities
  P[["model"]] <- apollo_mnl(
    mnl_settings,
    functionality
  )
  
  # Account for repeated choice tasks completed by each respondent
  P <- apollo_panelProd(
    P,
    apollo_inputs,
    functionality
  )
  
  # Prepare and return probabilities for model estimation
  P <- apollo_prepareProb(
    P,
    apollo_inputs,
    functionality
  )
  
  return(P)
}


# ESTIMATE MODEL


model <- apollo_estimate(
  apollo_beta,
  apollo_fixed,
  apollo_probabilities,
  apollo_inputs
)

# DISPLAY AND SAVE MODEL RESULTS

apollo_modelOutput(model)

apollo_saveOutput(model)

# CREATE MNL RESULTS TABLE

# Extract coefficient estimates and robust standard errors
# from the estimated Apollo model
results_table <- data.frame(
  parameter = names(model$estimate),
  estimate = as.numeric(model$estimate),
  robust_se = as.numeric(model$robse)
)

# Add labels for the ASC and DCE attribute levels
results_table <- results_table |>
  mutate(
    attribute = c(
      "Alternative-specific constant",
      rep("Proximity", 3),
      rep("Amenities", 3),
      rep("Plant type", 3),
      rep("Plant type x Arizona residency", 2),
      rep("Safety", 3),
      rep("Shade", 3),
      rep("Accessibility", 3)
    ),
    
    level = c(
      "Alternative A vs. B",
      
      # Proximity
      ">4 miles",
      "2-4 miles",
      "1 mile",
      
      # Amenities
      "Gathering areas",
      "Nature play",
      "No additional amenities",
      
      # Plant type
      "Mostly native plants",
      "Mix of native and non-native plants",
      "Mostly non-native plants",
      
      # Interactions
      "Mostly native plants x long-term AZ",
      "Mostly non-native plants x long-term AZ",
      
      # Safety
      "No safety features",
      "Lighting",
      "Patrol",
      
      # Shade
      "Shade from ramada",
      "Shade from a tree",
      "No shade",
      
      # Accessibility
      "Mostly paved paths and accessible amenities",
      "Some natural paths and limited accessibility routes",
      "No paths and no accessibility routes"
    )
  )

# Calculate robust test statistics and identify reference levels
results_table <- results_table |>
  mutate(
    robust_t = estimate / robust_se,
    p_value = 2 * pnorm(-abs(robust_t)),
    
    reference = case_when(
      parameter == "asc_A" ~ "B is reference",
      is.na(robust_se) ~ "Reference",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  )

# Create a clean table for reporting
final_results <- results_table |>
  transmute(
    Attribute = attribute,
    Level = level,
    Estimate = round(estimate, 3),
    `Robust SE` = round(robust_se, 3),
    `Robust t` = round(robust_t, 2),
    `p-value` = case_when(
      is.na(p_value) ~ "",
      p_value < .001 ~ "< .001",
      TRUE ~ sprintf("%.3f", p_value)
    ),
    Reference = reference
  )

final_results

```
